title: Button model missing overDownToIdle and idleToOverDown event types
description: Ruffle's ButtonActionCondition defines 9 event bits. The Flash 8 clone's ButtonAction.event union type (types.ts:295-303) and the encoder's eventBitMap (buttons.ts:412-420) expose only 7. Missing: 'overDownToIdle' (bit 8 = 0x100, fired when mouse leaves button while held down) and 'idleToOverDown' (bit 7 = 0x80, fired when button is directly pressed without a rollover). Fix: add both event names to the ButtonAction.event union type and add entries to the eventBitMap with correct bit values 0x100 and 0x80.
